limits: Fingertips use authored planar compliant rubber boxes.
Arm follows prescribed joint positions; no motor dynamics or full robot mesh contact.
This checks pose/contact placement, not force calibration.
physical_input_precision: Native path reader casts CSV pose fields to FP32; the exported forces and contact points come from the GPU contact buffer.
normal_force_definition: Legacy channel names denote negative-normal and positive-normal planes respectively. Values are position contact multipliers divided by dt squared; velocity impulses act at the same recorded nodes.
